title: EGFR Resistance Topology: Structural Footprints of Targeted-Therapy Resistance Mutations in the EGFR Kinase Pocket
description: A topology-aware preliminary study quantifying how EGFR targeted-therapy (osimertinib) resistance mutations mark the drug-binding pocket. Using osimertinib-bound structures (controlling for ligand-induced fit), per-residue structural deformation grades resistance mutations (L858R > T790M > C797S); C797S is structurally near-silent, reflecting that its resistance is chemical (loss of the covalent anchor) rather than conformational. Persistent homology and Hausdorff analysis on public RCSB PDB structures. Preliminary technical report, not peer-reviewed.
